notes: Read deposit page, paper model 3 (speech-turn LMM, y ~ x + n_words + (1 | speaker) + (1 | coder)) and the Methods on speech-turn coding. One worksheet is one conversation group watching one movie, coded by one coder (AW): coder is constant and not a column, so only speaker is a grouping factor; n_words is not a column (words would be counted from statement) so it is dropped from the covariates. RULE GAP: the paper fits one model per 1-10 coder rating plus one with speech-turn type as predictor; speaker_confidence is taken as the response and event_type as the covariate, an inferred pairing. The other ratings (content_accepted, speaker_deference, matter_fact) are alternate responses in ignore.
